<?php

$stdin = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
$stdout = fopen('php://stdout', 'w');

$data = fread($stdin, 1024 * 10);
$tokens = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($data));

$n = (int)$tokens[0];
$k = (int)$tokens[1];

$nn = $n;
$ex = 1;

while ($n % 10 == 0) {
    $n /= 10;
    $k--;
}

while ($k > 0) {
    if ($n % 2 == 0) {
        $ex *= 5;
        $n /= 2;
        $k--;
    } elseif ($n % 5 == 0) {
        $ex *= 2;
        $n /= 5;
        $k--;
    } else {
        break;
    }
}

while ($k > 0) {
    $ex *= 10;
    $k--;
}

fwrite($stdout, ($ex * $nn) . "\n");
fclose($stdin);
fclose($stdout);

<?php

function solve() {
    $stdin = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
    $stdout = fopen('php://stdout', 'w');

    // Read n and k
    // Using fscanf for simplicity as input is just two integers
    if (!fscanf($stdin, "%d %d", $n, $k)) {
        return;
    }

    $nn = $n;
    $ex = 1;

    // Remove trailing zeros from n
    while ($n % 10 == 0) {
        $n = (int)($n / 10);
        $k--;
    }

    // Factor out 2s and 5s to form 10s
    while ($k > 0) {
        if ($n % 2 == 0) {
            $ex *= 5;
            $n = (int)($n / 2);
            $k--;
        } elseif ($n % 5 == 0) {
            $ex *= 2;
            $n = (int)($n / 5);
            $k--;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    // Remaining k factors of 10
    while ($k > 0) {
        $ex *= 10;
        $k--;
    }

    fwrite($stdout, ($ex * $nn) . "\n");
    
    fclose($stdin);
    fclose($stdout);
}

solve();
